findings.summary: cambium/registry.json and other registries refer to the hands/taste organ directory as "Skill-clusters" while the actual folder on disk is lowercase "skill-clusters" (lane5: 'No git at folder level ... skill-clusters (thoughtseed/skill-clusters, and registry says dir "Skill-clusters")'). Flagged here only; no registry file was modified by this task.

The thoughtseed-hermes repo's PROJECT.md identifies it as the retired Paperclip plane (program:paperclip-retired), not the live Hermes runtime -- the name is misleading. The live Hermes runtime is hermes-aws-ts (lane2-hermes.md section 1).

The cortex organ is registered twice: cambium/registry.json lists it as taste-nim + brandmint DESIGN_MEMORY_WORKER, while the live implementation is cambium/workers/cortex-mcp (hosted Nemotron-3 per commit c464355). Lane5 notes "I3 unifies" as an open reconciliation item.
The lane5 sketch marks the plexus-ts -> session-atlas edge with a trailing "?" as explicitly unverified. Carried into this graph as evidence:doc-inferred, confidence:low.

Per lane5 gaps: no machine-readable cross-repo edge list existed before this file; DEPENDENCY-GRAPH.md only covers intra-repo apps/workers->shared edges and SERVICES.md is empty. This graph is a first proposal-only pass, not a replacement registry.
